title: The weather
summary: An app that asks a real weather service on the Internet for the temperature (Open-Meteo, free and without a key).
done: Your app talks to a real service on the Internet! A connection, a call, a field of the answer: that is how most apps work. Try showing the wind too (current=temperature_2m,wind_speed_10m).

welcome.text: We will ask **Open-Meteo**, a free weather service, for the temperature in Paris. Calls go through the Rublox server: you need to be signed in.

go-data.text: Open the **Data** tab: tables and API connections live there.

add-api.text: Create an **API connection** with the **+** next to “API connections”.

base-url.text: In **Base address**, write `https://api.open-meteo.com/v1`. You can also rename the connection “Weather”.

params.hint: The server adds them to each call: …/forecast?latitude=48.85&longitude=2.35&current=temperature_2m

try.text: Write `/forecast` in **Path** and press **Try**. In the answer, open **current** and click **temperature_2m**: Rublox creates the block that reads this field.

go-blocks.text: Go to the **Blocks** tab: your new block is waiting there.

wire.text: Add [when {{Button}} is clicked], put [set text of {{Text}} to …] inside, and plug your [current.temperature_2m of answer of …] block into it.

run.text: In the preview, press the button: the temperature in Paris shows up, in degrees!
